mapper.select: SELECT si.stock_code security_code ,si.security_type ,si.market_code market FROM rrs_stockinfo si INNER JOIN dict_security_type st ON st.security_type = si.security_type AND st.category_type = 'stock' AND st.is_deleted = 0 WHERE si.stock_code = #{stockCode} AND si.is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT DISTINCT ms.security_code FROM my_security_pool ms INNER JOIN rrs_stockinfo si ON si.stock_code = ms.security_code AND si.is_deleted = 0 AND si.security_type = ms.security_type AND si.market_code = ms.market INNER JOIN dict_security_type st ON st.security_type = si.security_type AND st.category_type = 'stock' AND st.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ms.user_id = #{userId} AND ms.status = 'use' ORDER BY ms.security_code
